items.label: Toaster

product.name: toaster
product.author: AtTheSpeedOf
product.credit: toaster by AtTheSpeedOf, CC BY 4.0; scaled and positioned; separate kitchen reflection bake.

items.notes: Hamilton Beach substitute for the Black & Decker in the photograph. Original three PBR texture maps are preserved.

items.label: Blue jug / miniature creamer
items.notes: Photo-built miniature creamer, about 5.1 cm tall. Glazed finish; its handle, lip and unseen surfaces remain approximate.

items.label: Telephone
items.notes: Existing licensed desk phone retained with its photo-fitted labels and controls. Casing edges receive a small physical bevel and smooth shading. Alternative free phones were reviewed, but did not improve the photographed layout.

items.label: Left canister
items.notes: Photo-built ceramic jar. Lid hardware and the printed motif remain approximate.

items.label: Right canister
items.notes: Photo-built ceramic jar. Lid hardware and the printed motif remain approximate.

items.label: Soap Bottle
items.notes: Photo-built foam-pump bottle. Pump shape, translucency and label remain approximate.

items.label: Soap Dish
items.notes: Resized dish and soap to fit the narrow space behind the sink; smaller than the photographed dish.

items.label: Bottles
items.notes: Four photo-traced bottles with photo-derived labels. Glass and unseen label details remain approximate.

items.label: Paper Towel
items.notes: Photo-built holder and roll. Paper seams and fine paper texture are not reconstructed.

items.label: Wooden caddy
items.notes: Photo-built caddy with photo-derived decoration. Slats, joinery and partly hidden contents remain approximate.

items.label: Knife Block

product.name: Knife Holder with a Cutting Board
product.author: Patrik

items.notes: Downloaded detailed knife holder and five knives, with rounded black handles, steel rivets, baked wood grain and the native sharpening stone. The holder profile and missing scissors differ from the photo.

items.label: Knife Block Round
items.notes: Photo-built oval holder with smoothly rounded stainless-steel handles. Small rim bevels preserve the holder profile; the exact knife blades and cap slots remain approximate.

items.label: Grinder

product.name: Knife Holder with a Cutting Board
product.author: Patrik

items.notes: Photo-built open-hopper grinder retained for silhouette fidelity. Licensed wood texture applied to its dark case; edges beveled and metal parts smoothed. The texture source is a knife holder, not a downloaded grinder model.

items.label: Stovetop kettle
items.notes: Original licensed kettle restored as separate steel and plastic parts, with a subdivided curved body and true reflective PBR metal. The body profile remains a substitute.

items.label: Hot Tap
items.notes: Licensed antique-faucet spout combined with a photo-shaped slim stem, flange and lower lever. Bronze patina texture is procedural; the exact original tap is not reproduced.

items.label: Sink soap pump
items.notes: Photo-traced and fitted pump with a metallic finish; unseen details remain approximate.

items.label: Sink air gap
items.notes: Photo-traced fitted shape with metallic finish.

items.label: Frog statues
items.notes: Approximate proxy sculptures. The mesh is less faithful than parts of the earlier photo-trained Gaussian view.

items.label: Tea Tray
items.notes: Downloaded ceramic teapot with curved handle and spout, photo-coloured reactive glaze. Tray retained; sugar jar rebuilt from the photo. Decorative glaze details remain approximate.

items.label: Glass Kettle
items.notes: Downloaded glass electric-kettle substitute with clear glass transmission, detailed spout and curved handle. The photo has a rounder body and a different lid.

items.label: Frother
items.notes: Downloaded Aeroccino ribbed body and lid adapted to the handle-free black photographed type, with a photo-shaped subdivided base and chrome collar. Exact logo, lid and power cable details remain approximate.

items.label: Coffee Machine
items.notes: Earlier licensed Nespresso substitute retained because it more closely matches the photographed silhouette. Curved housing receives two levels of Catmull-Clark subdivision with hard-edge creases, and chrome is restored to reflective PBR. Fine controls still differ.
